verdict.rationale: Asaas documents API-created subaccounts, which cover seller onboarding, and split settings on payment creation, which cover dividing a payment between parties. Both appear only as brief feature mentions, and nothing explicitly documents how split funds are routed and paid out to each seller. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of split recipient configuration and per-seller payout or settlement, details of subaccount onboarding and KYC, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a marketplace flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Through the API, you can create subaccounts so that each customer has an individual account, carries out financial operations, and manages their own payments.
Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
